batch_config.name: ode_epsilon_floor_extraction_scan_v1
batch_config.purpose: Estimate the minimum dynamically attainable epsilon, characterize near-floor behavior, and measure the smallest stable resolvable increment above the observed floor without prematurely naming the derived unit.

paper_alignment.primary_question: Does the local epsilon-rho-R system approach a nonzero floor under extreme suppression, and how does behavior change in the near-floor regime?
paper_alignment.secondary_question: Is the system approaching a hard floor, an asymptotic nonzero limit, or a weakly coupled oscillatory regime near minimum epsilon?

core_measurement_policy.naming_rule: Do not assign a formal unit name in outputs. Treat all extracted quantities as pre-lexical operational measurements.

assumptions_for_agent: Preserve existing solver behavior unless additive instrumentation is required.
Emit all resolved parameter values in each manifest.
If exact runtime schema differs, adapt field names minimally while preserving sweep intent.
If the solver can emit denser time samples near minimum epsilon, do so and record the policy in manifest.

initial_condition_families.name: tiny_epsilon_pressure_favored
initial_condition_families.notes: Pushes the system close to the smallest practical epsilon start.

initial_condition_families.name: small_epsilon_pressure_favored
initial_condition_families.notes: Slightly less extreme start to test floor convergence robustness.

initial_condition_families.name: moderate_balanced
initial_condition_families.notes: Reference start for comparison against floor-seeking starts.

scan_stages.goal: Estimate minimum epsilon with residue support disabled and growth weakened.
scan_stages.expected_value: Primary floor-seeking sweep with support removed.

scan_stages.goal: Drive rho dominance while keeping epsilon growth extremely weak.
scan_stages.expected_value: Tests whether epsilon approaches a lower nonzero band under strong pressure dominance.

scan_stages.goal: Measure the smallest stable distinguishable increment above the observed floor candidates.
scan_stages.expected_value: Supports estimation of delta_epsilon_min_resolved near the smallest observed stable band.

scan_stages.goal: Check whether small residue support shifts the floor or only alters near-floor oscillation amplitude.
scan_stages.expected_value: Separates floor existence from support-driven lift away from floor.

analysis_rules.epsilon_floor_estimate_rule: Estimate epsilon_floor from the mean of epsilon over the final window when epsilon remains bounded and non-runaway.
analysis_rules.near_floor_bandwidth_rule: Compute last_window_max - last_window_min for epsilon over the final window.
analysis_rules.near_floor_oscillation_amplitude_rule: Use half the peak-to-peak epsilon amplitude in the final window.
analysis_rules.delta_epsilon_min_resolved_rule: Estimate from the smallest stable separation between repeated near-floor trajectories that remain distinguishable over the final window.
analysis_rules.diagnostic_requirement: If all runs remain clearly above a low-epsilon band, diagnostic_note.md must state that no floor-near regime was reached in the scanned region.

minimum_success_conditions: At least one reproducible low-epsilon near-floor regime is identified, OR
It is documented that the scanned local ODE system resists approach to a low-epsilon floor under the tested forcing.
target_figures: table of epsilon_min_observed across floor-seeking stages
near-floor bandwidth/amplitude comparison for top candidates

notes_to_agent: Do not convert this into a naming or lexicon task; keep it purely operational and measurement-focused.
If a candidate near-floor regime is found, prioritize local refinement around that parameter set before expanding the sweep elsewhere.
Negative rho values should be flagged and not silently treated as physically meaningful.
All run ids should include stage_id and initial_condition_family.
